name: capacity-planning-evaluation
description: JEV criteria for evaluating optimal capacity adjustments based on resource usage trends and historical prediction accuracy

options.description: Increase the number of running instances to handle growing demand
Change to larger instance types with more CPU and memory resources
Increase memory allocation without changing CPU or instance count
Configure automatic scaling policies to dynamically adjust capacity based on real-time demand
Rebalance resource allocation across services to improve overall utilization efficiency

evaluation_factors: Current and historical resource usage trends (CPU, memory, disk)
Growth rate patterns and seasonality indicators
Historical accuracy of capacity predictions for similar situations
Risk of over-provisioning vs under-provisioning resources
Cost implications of different capacity adjustment strategies
